Package com.kerosene.kfe.adapters.out.persistence.model.audit

Class KfeAuditLogEntity

java.lang.Object
com.kerosene.kfe.adapters.out.persistence.model.audit.KfeAuditLogEntity
@Entity public class KfeAuditLogEntity extends Object
Persists one immutable-in-intent entry in the financial audit event stream.

The row stores event context and hashes instead of the original payload. previousHash links the entry to the preceding event and eventHash identifies this event in that chain; the generated sequence provides a database ordering key for querying the stream. This entity maps persistence data only: callers are responsible for calculating and validating the hashes before saving the row.
